sample_representation.duplicate_sample_rule: within each normalized species name, retain the first source-table row in original Supplementary Table S1 row order

taxon_mapping.primary_key: normalized binomial genus + species epithet from source labels
allowed_pre_outcome_repairs: source-documented spelling or synonym mapping supported without consulting colour/pigment values
forbidden_repairs: drop or rename a taxon because its observed resolution profile improves
choose among duplicate samples using any colour, pigment, reflectance, or anthocyanin value
taxon_mapping.hard_stop: HOLD_CROSSWALK if a one-to-one species/tree mapping cannot be frozen without outcome values

fine.definition: source reflectance colour group under the Chittka-style 300-700 nm classification reported by Ogutcen et al. 2020
fine.rule: use the source-reported categorical colour-group label verbatim after trivial string normalization; do not derive new cutpoints from target values
fine.rare_state_rule: exclude fine states represented by fewer than 5 retained species from the common three-resolution frame

common_frame: all three AUCs use exactly the same retained species after duplicate resolution, tree matching, ambiguity filtering, and the frozen <5 fine-state exclusion

preflight_must_not_read: any CHUN-computed AUC or resolution ordering
